title: Measurement of Fecal Neutral Sterol Excretion and Fractional Cholesterol Absorption
author: Ryan Temel Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iy9cfz6

steps.title: Prepare Sterol Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare a sterol solution in vegetable oil and ensure complete dissolution.

substeps.instruction: Add 8mg of [26, 26, 26, 27, 27, 27- 2 H 6] cholesterol and 8mg of [2, 2, 4, 4, 6- 2 H 5] sitostanol to 4mL of vegetable oil in a 7mL scintillation vial.
Stir vigorously with a stir bar for over an hour until sterols are completely dissolved.

steps.title: Dose Mice
steps.instruction: Administer the sterol mixture to mice using a gavage needle.

substeps.instruction: Using a stainless steel gavage needle attached to a 250µL Hamilton syringe, dose each mouse with 50µL of the sterol mixture.
Ensure all bubbles are removed when pulling the mixture into the syringe.
Expel any unused mixture back into the Eppendorf tube to avoid waste.

steps.title: Collect and Store Feces
steps.instruction: House mice and collect fecal samples after the dosing period.

substeps.instruction: House mice singly in wire bottom cages lined with paper towels for 72 hours with free access to food and water.
After 72 hours, weigh the mice.
Collect feces, removing any attached food particles or paper towels.
Store feces in 20mL scintillation vials at -20°C.

steps.title: Dry Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Desiccate the feces to determine dry weight.

substeps.instruction: Place vials in a vacuum oven set at 80°C overnight.
Weigh the feces to determine the total fecal dry weight.
Store dried feces at room temperature if not processed immediately.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare glass tubes with internal standards and dried feces.

substeps.instruction: Wear a mask and lab coat while crushing feces into a fine powder using a mortar and pestle.
Place ~100 µg 5-alpha cholestane into 16x100mm glass screw top tubes.
Dry off the solvent under N2 in the heating block.
Add ~100 mg of dried feces to the tubes and record the exact weight.

steps.title: Saponify and Extract Sterols
steps.instruction: Perform alkaline hydrolysis and solvent extraction of the fecal sterols.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ml 95% EtOH and 200 µl 50% KOH to the tube.
Cap the tube and incubate at ~60°C for 3 hours with periodic vortexing.
Add 2 ml hexane and vortex.
Add 2 ml water and vortex.
Centrifuge the tube at 2,700 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Isolate the hexane phase and prepare for GC analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper hexane phase to a clean 4 mL vial.
Dry off the solvent using N2.
Resuspend the extract in 50-100µL of hexane.
Transfer the resuspension to a GC vial for analysis.
